notes.title: Announcement: Path of the Abyss ver. 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Update Details (ver. 1.0.0)
New Features Added
[olist]
 An ending credits sequence now plays upon clearing the game.
 Steam achievements have been added.
 Additional character portraits have been added.
 Simplified Chinese language support has been added.
[/olist]

Balance Adjustments
[olist]
 Adjusted monster HP values.
 Increased the duration of certain skills.
 Strengthened the effects of some Epic-tier equipment.
 Enhanced the effects of certain mutations.
[/olist]

notes.title: Announcement of next major update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience. We are pleased to announce the release date of the next major update (ver 0.12.0).

Update Date 2024/10/5 night (time to be determined)

Update Details
 New Elements 
- An additional dungeon "Reverberating Nightmare" will be implemented, which can be played after clearing the main scenario!

Changed elements
 - Major revision of blessed equipment
 - Base damage enhancement of various skills
 - Enhancement of various synergies and enhancements
 - Enhancement of various equipment
 - Various other changes

The developers will explain the above updates in the following schedule. 
Afternoon of 10/5/2024 (time TBD) 
https://www.twitch.tv/suzuki_suzuzou

notes.title: English Support for Early Access Version
notes.notes:
Even during Early Access, you can switch to the English version from the in-game options.
However, since the game is mostly machine-translated, it is only available in Japanese on the Steam store page.
If you don't mind machine translation, you can switch to English from the in-game options. Please do not expect quality as it is a machine translation.
